Container.Name: greenmark-dmarc
Container.Overview: Self-hosted DMARC aggregate report monitor. Reads DMARC reports from an IMAP mailbox, stores them in SQLite and shows pass and fail results per domain.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Dashboard port

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, domains.yaml and import folder

Config.Name: Admin user
Config.Description: Dashboard login name

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Dashboard login password

Config.Name: IMAP host
Config.Description: Mail server that receives the DMARC reports

Config.Name: IMAP port
Config.Description: 993 for IMAPS

Config.Name: IMAP user
Config.Description: Mailbox login, for example dmarc@yourdomain

Config.Name: IMAP password
Config.Description: Mailbox password

Config.Name: IMAP folder
Config.Description: Folder to read reports from

Config.Name: Archive folder
Config.Description: Processed report emails are moved here

Config.Name: Poll minutes
Config.Description: How often to check the mailbox

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: Mail server for alerts and the weekly summary. Empty turns email off.

Config.Name: SMTP port
Config.Description: 587 with STARTTLS, or 465 with SSL

Config.Name: SMTP security
Config.Description: starttls, ssl or none

Config.Name: SMTP user
Config.Description: SMTP login. Empty uses the IMAP user.

Config.Name: SMTP password
Config.Description: SMTP password. Empty uses the IMAP password.

Config.Name: From address
Config.Description: Empty uses the SMTP or IMAP user

Config.Name: Alert email to
Config.Description: Failure alerts, one email per problem (for example your ticketing inbox)

Config.Name: Weekly summary to
Config.Description: Weekly summary recipients

Config.Name: Summary day
Config.Description: Day the weekly summary is sent

Config.Name: Summary hour
Config.Description: Hour (0-23) the weekly summary is sent

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Time zone for the summary schedule
